classification_meanings.A: Portable upstream numerical tests copied byte-identically
classification_meanings.B: Portable signal guarantees retained with coefficient-copy helper adaptation
classification_meanings.C: Upstream detection-position/private-state limitation not portable to the new processor contract
classification_meanings.D: New or replacement offline unit/boundary coverage, not an unchanged-upstream pass

source_accounting.runtime_evidence: Central integration JSON/XML is authoritative; local compile/sanitizer evidence is separate

B_files.adaptation: Three setup helpers replace vDSP_biquad_CreateSetup/swapSetup with production replaceCoefficients; all signal assertions, input values and tolerances retained
Three setup helpers use coefficient-copy; all remaining original methods retain assertions except individually classified C methods below; NativeAudio import names explicit C status codes

C_to_D.reason: Requires mid-buffer NaN to escape an old first-frame-only vDSP output detector, an implementation limitation rather than the new finite-signal contract
C_to_D.replacement_guarantee: Same frame-500 NaN injection reports NONFINITE_SIGNAL, mutes the entire block and does not leak non-finite output

C_to_D.reason: Requires poisoned vDSP delays to survive one call and mute the next clean call; the new owner resets state in the failing call
C_to_D.replacement_guarantee: Next clean block immediately succeeds and matches a fresh independently configured processor sample-for-sample

C_to_D.reason: Requires an isNaN-only old detector to miss infinity and contaminate later output
C_to_D.replacement_guarantee: Same frame-zero infinity reports NONFINITE_SIGNAL and bounded whole-block mute; scalar limiter IEEE expectations remain unchanged in A

guarantees: First sample and one-sided short sound survive without startup fade/gate
Silence advances real filter tails and short sound resumes after silence
Per-route EQ/history and per-channel delays are independent
Invalid executable configuration returns explicit errors without partial mutation
Native configuration copies own values and survive source destruction with fresh history
RT processing performs no C++ heap allocation; full executable passes ASan and UBSan
Offline mutation replacing per-channel delays with shared channel-0 state is detected

approval: Lead explicitly approved coefficient-boundary helper adaptation, the three C-to-D substitutions, finite detection inside the ordinary loop, and frozen history during disabled bypass on 2026-11-04 JST
limitations: No hardware audio, OS permission, concurrent handoff or long-duration performance verification
ISO official edition/range checked; paid standard full-table independent verification not claimed
Passing unit tests is not a claim that upstream issues or product-wide compatibility are solved
